headline: OpenAI holds DevDay 2026 keynote with Sam Altman in San Francisco
summary: OpenAI hosted its annual DevDay 2026 event in San Francisco on September 29th, with CEO Sam Altman delivering a live keynote covering ChatGPT and Codex announcements. The company teased more than 20 launches, with Altman saying 'we have found a new thing.'
